populated.low_momentum_preparation: momentum weight concentrated at p = 0 (Gaussian of width w: weight near another zero p* ~ exp(-w^2 |p*|^2)); the blank record is (|+> + |->)/sqrt2, so both arrow sectors: the p = 0 cone of each sector; all four sublattices.
populated.single_cell_preparation: equal momentum weight at every p of the full zone, so every zero of both arrow sectors (blank record); it sits on one sublattice, on which zeros in the same class modulo (pi,pi,0), (pi,0,pi), (0,pi,pi) are the same cone of that sublattice.

phase_pi_points.definition: points where U2_s = -1 (two-tick phase pi, pi/2 per tick); same search and linearisation applied to -U2
